title: Activate Dynamic Governance-Controlled Emissions: 60% Validators, 40% AI Inference
summary: Activate governance-controlled emissions with 60% to validators and 40% to AI inference providers
description: This proposal activates the new dynamic governance-controlled emissions system, replacing the hardcoded 50/50 split with a flexible 60/40 distribution that can be adjusted through future governance proposals. This gives 60% of newly minted tokens to validator rewards (fee_collector) and 40% to AI inference provider rewards (inferencerewards). The system provides complete governance control over emission parameters while maintaining network security and incentivizing AI infrastructure development.
